title: Wrong intelligence table
problem: Bob read lead_intel_packets while REI writes intel_packets.
repair: Canonical intel_packets reads and tenant-bound snapshots.

title: Wrong seller-memory table
problem: Bob read seller_memory while Sophia saves memory on leads.
repair: Canonical leads memory and fresh verified checklist evidence.

title: Fixed stale cutoff
problem: The supposed 24-hour refresh used a fixed June 7, 2026 timestamp.
repair: Rolling dates and database job deadlines/source invalidation.

title: Fragile reverse foreign-key relationship
problem: Lead selection assumed properties_lead_id_fkey while REI creates leads using property_id.
repair: Canonical property_id join in tenant-bound snapshots.

title: Events scheduled on an idle loop
problem: The synchronous worker scheduled coroutines but never ran the event loop; exceptions were swallowed.
repair: Synchronous bounded transport draining a durable outbox.

title: HTTP rejection counted as delivery
problem: The sender never checked HTTP status.
repair: Only 2xx acceptance plus owned DB acknowledgment counts.

title: Event path and authentication mismatch
problem: Bob omitted the /api/ingest prefix and the secret convention used by REI. Receiver implementation was not provided.
repair: Explicit full BOB_EVENT_URL targets a tested authenticated REI receiver with exact committed-event binding and persisted acknowledgment. Inspected Karpathys route does not exist; no guessed external route.

title: No durable event retry
problem: Events disappeared on process death, disabled URL or transient errors.
repair: Transactional outbox, owned leases, bounded retries and dead-letter state.

title: False ready-to-call events
problem: Any generated brief emitted lead-ready regardless of contact/consent/packet authority.
repair: Removed automatic lead-ready output. Brief explicitly cannot authorize dialing.

title: Previous calls invented ownership
problem: Any call summary, including wrong-number or voicemail, counted as confirmed owner.
repair: Require fresh explicit confirmed evidence; denial overrides previous confirmations.

title: Generic hot topics invented property condition
problem: Any hot_topics value skipped condition discovery.
repair: Require condition-specific verified checklist evidence.

title: Database address invented caller confirmation
problem: A stored address skipped property confirmation.
repair: Only matching spoken address evidence or verified checklist confirmation qualifies.

title: Malformed inputs crashed planning
problem: Invalid motivation, distress, profiles and list fields could fail a lead or contaminate output.
repair: Validate object/list types; tolerate unavailable packet dates; malformed jobs retry then quarantine.

title: Confidence implied unsupported accuracy
problem: Packet-state labels generated 0.9/0.95 confidence with no calibrated evaluation.
repair: Confidence is explicitly checklist completeness, not correctness probability.

title: Distress record invented current emotion
problem: Probate or foreclosure labels directly assigned seller mood.
repair: Unknown unless seller-sourced evidence supplies a supported mood; Sophia rechecks current emotion.

title: Approval threshold inflated 100 times
problem: 25,000,000 cents rendered as $25,000,000 instead of $250,000.
repair: Integer cents validated and Decimal dollars formatted correctly.

title: Completed checklist could never wrap
problem: Selector always returned next_step; generator could not reach completed WRAP.
repair: Explicit none state and exhaustive 128-subset priority tests.

title: Malformed brief could crash Sophia
problem: Non-string enum fields, wrong lists and invalid dates were not validated.
repair: Bounded typed validation; invalid metadata clears old guidance and is ignored.

title: No tenant boundary in Bob
problem: Service-role reads/writes filtered only lead IDs, bypassing tenant RLS.
repair: All RPCs, sources, reads and event state are tenant-bound; public/anon/authenticated RPC access revoked.

title: STOP described as operator escalation
problem: STOP was an escalation item with no explicit immediate suppression priority.
repair: STOP is immediate suppression/end; never wait for approval.

title: Duplicate workers could process the same lead
problem: No claiming, generation ownership or crash recovery.
repair: Skip-locked atomic claims and generation tokens; expired lease reclaimed.

title: Partial saves created false completion
problem: Brief save, decision log and events were independent; logging failures swallowed.
repair: Single transaction for brief, decision and outbox; failure rolls all back.

title: Stale planner could overwrite newer source
problem: A lead, memory or packet change between read and write was not detected.
repair: Fingerprint current tenant-bound snapshot; lock relevant source rows before commit.

title: Unbounded network delay and restart behavior
problem: Client defaults and whole-batch claiming could consume a lease before a job began.
repair: Ten-second DB timeout, three-second HTTP timeout, one-at-a-time claims and bounded generation leases.

title: Missing row could be reported saved
problem: Updates did not verify a changed row or owned commit.
repair: Boolean transactional RPC acknowledgment required; no confirmed commit means error.

title: No brief version, binding or expiry
problem: Sophia accepted cached arbitrary brief data without lead identity or freshness checks.
repair: V2 schema, bound lead, UTC timestamps, bounded lifetime and no authority flag.

title: Useful briefing fields loaded but unused
problem: Mood, opener, escalation rules and objective were stored but largely absent from model guidance.
repair: Valid advisory fields included; current call policy and tool permissions retain priority.

title: Static focus could repeat answered questions
problem: Bob focus was injected for the entire conversation without acknowledging live progress.
repair: Pre-call focus/objective/opening hints stop after the early turns; guardrails remain.

title: Feedback had no verified producer/consumer bridge
problem: Bob read different memory and prior calls/topics were substituted for proof.
repair: Actual cross-repository round trip plus per-turn WAL fact journal, acknowledged Supabase receipt, retry/replay and recovery process. Production persistence acceptance tracked separately.

title: Two incompatible Bob planner implementations
problem: Repositories define different missing-box vocabularies, escalation keys and generator signatures.
repair: Removed inactive REI embedded planner, legacy brief contract and owner-call fallback generator. Standalone V2 Bob is the explicit source for this integration; separate Sophia rebuild tracked separately.

title: Missing clean database baseline
problem: Bob shipped no migrations; REI still lacks definitions for all shared source tables.
repair: Bob-owned additions and RPCs supplied; complete existing REI baseline/introspection and clean installation remain required.

title: Tracked environment configuration
problem: A .env file was committed; checked service-key values were placeholders, not established live secrets.
repair: Removed from new tree and ignored; local file preserved. History remains unchanged.

title: No tests or hosted regression
problem: Original repository had no tests or CI.
repair: 206 Python tests, actual SQL contracts, coverage, lint and hosted workflow.

title: Unpinned dependencies and unused scheduler
problem: Install results could change and schedule was unused.
repair: Exact direct dependencies, uv transitive lock, Python bounds and removed unused dependency.

title: No graceful worker shutdown
problem: Infinite sleeping worker had no shutdown signal path.
repair: SIGTERM/SIGINT stop event; stop new claims between bounded jobs and event sends.

title: Operational alerting and real infrastructure unverified
problem: No heartbeat, dead-letter alert, retention policy or real multi-backend fault campaign.
repair: Durable quarantine/retry state and runbook available; production monitoring, retention and actual provider/database recovery remain required.

title: Market enrichment, simulations and autonomous underwriting absent
problem: Intel and scoring packages were empty; no comps ingestion, market reasoning model or evaluation loop exists here.
repair: Assign valuation to a verified comps service and permissions to human governance. Add sourced market/simulation roles only after their real contracts and evaluation gates exist.

title: Actual intel assembly mixed cents and dollars in conflict checks
problem: Helper unit tests used cents, but assembly passed dollar ARV/floor against cents max offer, manufacturing conflicts. Property profile money lacked a unit.
repair: Full assembly regression reproduces the error; comparisons and structured money preserve integer cents with USD_cents metadata. Invalid money denies through conflict state.

title: Unrelated speech refreshed old verified facts
problem: State carry-over was timestamped as new seller evidence.
repair: Record only newly observed facts and tool-confirmed next steps.

title: Spoken address rebound canonical property
problem: Wrong address replaced authenticated property address and could confirm itself on repetition.
repair: Preserve server-bound address; mismatches cannot confirm it.

title: Seller-sourced mood lacked freshness
problem: Source alone accepted ancient or untimed reported emotion.
repair: Require valid seller provenance and timestamp within 24 hours.

title: Equal-time confirmation could replace denial
problem: Equal timestamp replay used >= and could undo a denial.
repair: Denial takes precedence at equal timestamps; newer explicit evidence required.

title: Corrupt legacy facts poisoned merges
problem: Malformed old timestamp raised during valid new evidence merge.
repair: Treat malformed legacy timestamp as unverified; validate new evidence strictly.

title: Any HTTP success counted as persisted receipt
problem: Receiver HTML/unrelated 200 or mismatched receipt could drop delivery.
repair: Require persisted status and exact stable event ID.

title: Free-form strategy text entered guidance
problem: Source strings could carry arbitrary instructions into model context.
repair: Approved strategy codes map to fixed phrases; unknown strings never copied.

title: No schema/worker integration health contract
problem: Dead worker, missing contract and quarantine were not actively exposed.
repair: Startup contract verification, durable heartbeat, operator health and failure exit.

title: Separate Sophia rebuild has incompatible schema and Bob
problem: A second deployable owns a different planner and seller_memory/lead_intel_packets schema.
repair: Explicit REI target and fail-closed contract; rebuild remains a separate fallback pending migration decision.

title: Duplicate context and event function definitions
problem: Later definitions silently replaced earlier definitions.
repair: Removed duplicates; expanded static check includes F811.

title: Questions and hypothetical speech became positive facts
problem: Keywords in questions/conditional statements were treated as confirmed checklist evidence.
repair: Conservative question/hypothetical/third-party gating and direct motivation provenance tests.

title: Generic affirmative could confirm ownership
problem: Yes I can hear you / this is a bad time could set owner confirmation.
repair: Owner-answer shortcut accepts only a short identity affirmation; explicit ownership still follows analysis.

title: Restart durability depends on deployment volume
problem: Hangup-only memory was lost on crash; ephemeral container replacement still cannot retain a local journal.
repair: Per-turn durable local WAL, atomic remote receipts and replay tests implemented; real persistent-volume kill/restart test still required.
